subject: Using packages not on CRAN in shiny

messages.author: 7b72881378080971
messages.subject: Using packages not on CRAN in shiny
parts:
Hi,
I'm trying to run a shiny app, deployed on the shinyapps.io server, which uses the INLA package. This isn't available in CRAN and is downloaded via this link

install.packages("INLA", repos="https://www.math.ntnu.no/inla/R/stable")

If I include 

library(INLA)

in my server.R script, when I try to publish the app, it gives me the following error message

Error: Unable to retrieve package records for the following packages:
- 'INLA'

I tried using this 

if(!"INLA" %in% rownames(installed.packages())){
   install.packages("INLA", repos="https://www.math.ntnu.no/inla/R/stable")
  library(INLA)}

But it gives me the same error. Does anyone have a solution?

Thanks, Hugh

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Using packages not on CRAN in shiny
parts:
Sorry, packages must be on CRAN, BioConductor, R-forge (I think), or GitHub for us to be able to find them. The problem is that we need to reinstall the package from source to work on our Linux servers, and only those three specific types of repositories are supported by the tools we use (devtools and packrat).

I think other people have hit this issue before, you could try installing from this repo:

devtools::install_github("andrewzm/INLA")

It looks like it's from about six months ago. Alternatively, you could create your own GitHub repository and host the contents of the package source tarball there.

Sorry, I'm sure those aren't very satisfying answers...
